additional_info.body:
Dear Thibaut Hurand,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Vishal
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P9 170000893
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
V3noQJ
Problem Description
: Charging session fails
Troubleshooting
:
We have checked the charger logs for the same timestamp you have provided, but didn't find the same logs showing in the snapshot.
But upon reviewing the logs, we find out that the charging session is getting stopped because OCPP backend is sending Invalid status in the StartTransaction response.
2025-02-04T10:20:20.900195+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/46b724e26080[739]: OCPP: Received result: StartTransaction (95abbd77-75b2-4ba8-8d1a-0d8c157ebebf) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Invalid","expiryDate":"2025-02-11T10:20:00Z","parentIdTag":""},"transactionId":41537524}
2025-02-04T10:22:46.474997+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/46b724e26080[739]: OCPP: Received result: StartTransaction (234164e6-1983-4b59-add2-42ce0a2afa7a) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Invalid","expiryDate":"2025-02-11T10:22:00Z","parentIdTag":""},"transactionId":41537465}
For future reference, your case number is
0404102
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vishal Dhiman

additional_info.subject: Notes for NOC
additional_info.body:
Issue:
Customer first raised the ticket for charigng sessions getting failed. But in the logs we found that it is getting failed because OCPP is sending Invalid response to StartTransaction. Then customer had raised another issue regarding charging session. In the logs I found that IMD is having issues, just after the charging starts, IMD error appears, but in ideal condition, IMD is working fine. Other DC outlet is working fine.
IMD Error > Relay connection to PLC not checked
it is occurring just after the charging starts.
AI:
Need further log analysis. Please check the attached logs and the new logs from the charger if it is related to one specific EV or with all, to find if it is EV related to charger related issue.
logs-insights-results (5).csv
V3noQJ-logs.csv

additional_info.subject: Notes
additional_info.body:
Analysis conducted so far, as per the logs attached by Vishal in his timeline.
'IMD_BC2' changed from true – > 11 times
The IMD is experiencing issues where an error appears just after charging starts. However, under normal conditions, the IMD functions correctly.
